title: ai-playbook runbook-doc frontmatter (v1)
description: Frontmatter contract for docs/runbooks/<slug>.md. Disjoint with schema-rule-v1.json and schema-concept-v1.json per D9 — fields exclusive to other doc kinds are FORBIDDEN here.

schema.description: Schema versioning hook. MUST be 'runbook/v1' for this version.

slug.description: Authoritative identifier (D3). MUST match the filename stem.

description.description: One-line outcome statement. Surfaced in INDEX.md and mkdocs nav.

audience.description: Who reads this runbook. 'operator' = production / incident-response operator; 'developer' = day-to-day dev workflow; 'reviewer' = PR / release reviewer.

estimated_time.description: Human-readable estimate (e.g., '10-30 min', '1-4 h to mitigation'). Free-form.

prerequisite_runbooks.description: Optional list of runbook slugs the operator should be familiar with first.

last_validated.description: Optional D21 freshness marker. YYYY-MM-DD. Runbooks older than 180 days warn (non-fail).

$comment: Rule-only fields (paired_hardrule, activation, status, triggers, break_glass, applies_to, globs, rule_bundle) and concept-only fields (title, summary, tags) are intentionally absent — additionalProperties:false enforces disjointness with schema-rule-v1.json and schema-concept-v1.json per D9.
